_note: THE ticket structure, defined in the repo — the board drawer renders (and edits) tickets from this file, in this order. Add/remove/reorder sections here and every ticket follows; no board code change needed. kind: text (paragraph) | list (bullet items) | chips (short tokens). editable: whether the inline editor offers it. agents_must_execute: the QA/review gate agents are REQUIRED to execute each item in this section and report per-item results.

sections.label: Summary
sections.hint: What this is, in a paragraph a lead engineer reads first.

sections.label: Context / why
sections.hint: The decision behind it — why this, why now, what almost went wrong before.

sections.label: Acceptance criteria
sections.hint: Testable statements. Done means every one verified with evidence.

sections.label: QA — things to check (plain language)
sections.hint: Owner-authored, plain English. The QA gate agent MUST execute every item here and report pass/fail per item — e.g. 'open it on a phone-width window', 'try a name with an apostrophe', 'make sure the old tabs still work'.

sections.label: Review — things to look at (plain language)
sections.hint: Owner-authored focus areas for the adversarial reviewer — e.g. 'is anything editing a golden value directly?', 'could this leak synthetic data?'.

sections.label: Implementation notes
sections.hint: Key functions, decisions, gotchas — written for whoever touches this next.

sections.label: Verification plan
sections.hint: How done will be proven, before it's built.

sections.label: Verification — done
sections.hint: What was ACTUALLY run and OBSERVED — outputs, not intentions.

sections.label: Agentic review — findings
sections.hint: The fresh-context reviewer's findings + outcomes. 'none found' is valid; unrun is not.

sections.label: Agentic QA — per-check results
sections.hint: One line per qa_check + per acceptance criterion: PASS/FAIL + what was observed.

sections.label: Follow-ups
sections.hint: Discovered work → new tickets, linked here.
